summary.zh-CN: 通过独立 App Instance、候选版本探测、数据保留卸载和真实权限标识，让 Apps 成为可以长期使用的个人软件。
summary.en-US: Makes Apps dependable personal software with independent instances, candidate probing, data-preserving uninstall, and truthful permission labels.

body.zh-CN: 每个实例分别管理 data、config、state、cache、tmp 和 logs，应用代码与个人数据不再共用生命周期。
body.en-US: Each instance separates data, config, state, cache, tmp, and logs so app code and personal data no longer share a lifecycle.

body.zh-CN: 候选版本通过完整性、兼容性、数据 schema 和 Service 启动探测后才切换；失败时旧版本继续可用。
body.en-US: Candidates become active only after integrity, compatibility, data-schema, and Service startup checks; failures leave the current version available.

body.zh-CN: Apps 显示数据位置、占用、runtime profile 与隔离等级，并把原生进程明确标记为当前用户完整权限。
body.en-US: Apps shows data location, usage, runtime profile, and isolation, and labels native processes as full access under the current user.

body.zh-CN: Marketplace 从包内归一化能力，社区原生 Service App 不再直接进入公开目录。
body.en-US: Marketplace derives capabilities from the package and prevents community native Service Apps from entering the public catalog directly.

body.zh-CN: 开发态 Service 使用稳定实例目录，不再随临时运行目录删除数据。
body.en-US: Development Services use stable instance directories instead of losing data with temporary runtime directories.

title.en-US: Grants do not cross risk escalation

body.zh-CN: Service action 的风险提高后必须重新授权，旧 grant 不再自动匹配。
body.en-US: A Service action requires a new grant after its risk is raised; the previous grant no longer matches.

body.zh-CN: 既有 .napp 和 schema v1 应用继续可用；卸载默认保留数据，缺少迁移合同的 schema 变化会在激活前阻止。
body.en-US: Existing .napp and schema v1 apps remain supported; uninstall keeps data by default, while schema changes without a migration contract are blocked before activation.
